messages:
olivia: quick async standup for Helios Health — renewal in 18 days and adoption is dipping. They've reported repeated webhook timeouts from our delivery endpoint, plus a flaky signature mismatch. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8123.

maria: thanks olivia. saw the spike in 4/21 window, ETA on reproducing locally? any error samples we can pass to eng? :eyes:

olivia: pasted recent error snippet from their logs below. they see 504s and `Signature verification failed` intermittently.
```
POST /webhook/helios - 2025-04-21T14:02:11Z
status: 504
response_time_ms: 12042
headers: {"x-redwood-signature": "sha256=..."}
error: "Signature verification failed"
```

ajay: assigning to eng to triage — @derek can you take a look at the signature path + timeout behavior? sounds like either compute pressure on the receiver or our retry/backoff is too aggressive.

derek: on it. quick Q — is Helios on private or hosted route? I want to check NAT/egress perf.

olivia: hosted API (customer on dedicated but using hosted callbacks). they mentioned increased token usage last week after onboarding new flows.

derek: thanks. I'll check our egress metrics and the verification path. can someone drop the raw failing headers & payload (sanitized) into the ticket so I can replay?

maria: adding sanitized payload to CS-8123 now. also cc'ing their SE to confirm if they deployed any recent changes. :white_check_mark:

ajay: note for renewal convo — flagging this as adoption blocker in renewal playbook. maria, can you include a short note in the renewal deck about current mitigation (canary throttling + temporary signature relaxation) so AE team has talking points?

maria: yep will add. plan: temporary rate-limiter on our side + rollback option if it doesn't help. drafting now.

cs-bot: automated note — incident linked to CS-8123 has been created and assigned to eng oncall. Priority: P2.

olivia: blockers: waiting on eng triage and a replay. owner: @derek. I'll update customer and schedule a quick sync if eng needs their logs. next steps today: eng triage, renewal deck update, and check impact on usage metrics.

derek: started a quick runbook check and will post findings in thread within 1 hour. if I see it's our retry loop, I'll open a rollback PR. :hammer_and_wrench:

maria: thanks everyone — ping me if you want me to join the call with Helios later.

olivia: perfect — will keep this thread live and update. :rocket:
